_meta.what_this_is: Review histories for five hub concepts, the kind a boss-fight recall ledger accumulates. Each concept has an ordered list of review attempts with the day it happened and whether the learner recalled it (pass) or blanked (fail). A spaced-repetition scheduler turns this history into the next review date: recall well and the concept is pushed further out; blank and it must come back soon. The whole question is whether the scheduler reads the RESULT of each review or just counts that a review happened.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored histories so intervals and due dates are exact and checkable. No app, no clock -- 'today' is a fixed day passed in.
_meta.format: today: the current day; concepts [{name, history:[{day, result}]}] with result in {pass, fail}
